## Migration ledger

- initialize and notifications/initialized: replace with request-local metadata and server/discover.
- ping: remove from canonical server and tests.
- logging/setLevel: replace with request-local logLevel metadata, stderr for stdio, and OpenTelemetry for remote observability.
- notifications/roots/list_changed and Roots: pass directories or files through tool parameters, resource URIs, or server configuration.
- Sampling and includeContext legacy values: integrate directly with provider APIs when needed and omit or use none during compatibility.
- HTTP+SSE, GET endpoints, session headers, and SSE resumability: replace with Streamable HTTP POST and explicit retry.
- Dynamic Client Registration: prefer Client ID Metadata Documents with bounded fallback.
- resources subscribe methods: replace with subscriptions/listen.

Every adapter declares owner, supported era, telemetry, security consequences, sunset evidence, and removal gate.
MCP 2026-07-28 deprecation and removal migration: roots, sampling, logging, dynamic registration, HTTP+SSE, includeContext, ping, and legacy sessions
Remove canonical use of deleted protocol methods and migrate every deprecated feature to the specified replacement while preserving only bounded evidence-backed compatibility adapters.

A generated inventory finds every removed or deprecated symbol and classifies source, test, doc, package, and release-probe usage; Canonical 2026-07-28 code and public docs contain no initialize-state, ping, logging/setLevel, roots-change, legacy resource-subscription, session-header, SSE-resume, or tasks/result behavior; Every deprecated feature uses the specification migration path and has a dated compatibility and removal policy; Legacy adapters are isolated from canonical SDK policy and have protocol-era positive and negative tests; CI fails when a removed symbol or deprecated feature is reintroduced outside the explicit adapter allowlist
No new dependence on removed or deprecated MCP features
Inventory every legacy feature in source, tests, docs, packages, examples, and release probes and migrate it to the 2026-07-28 path
The current implementation does not carry dead protocol state or teach agents patterns scheduled for removal
The latest revision removes ping and several session or subscription behaviors and deprecates Roots, Sampling, Logging, Dynamic Client Registration, HTTP+SSE, and includeContext values
